repowise-dev/repowise#4107.title: Workspace failures & cancellation
repowise-dev/repowise#4107.detail: Preserved repository aliases in errors, propagated cancellation, and covered cleanup and callback failures with regression tests.

repowise-dev/repowise#3631.title: Deduplicate historical secret findings
repowise-dev/repowise#3631.detail: Stopped unchanged secrets being reported again across file versions while retaining their earliest known introduction.

brekkylab/backlot#733.title: Signature requirements for annotation writes
brekkylab/backlot#733.detail: Rejected unsigned and Signature V2 annotation writes, preserving selector and credential error precedence.

brekkylab/backlot#685.title: Query validation before CORS preflight
brekkylab/backlot#685.detail: Aligned OPTIONS selector refusals with S3 behavior and added regression cases for bucket and object request paths.

scarletkc/Hatoba#178.title: Update progress layout
scarletkc/Hatoba#178.detail: Removed the progress-track width cap so it fills the available text column; checked responsive layouts, themes, and locales.

scarletkc/Hatoba#242.title: Ordered terminal-key input
scarletkc/Hatoba#242.detail: Co-authored the merged terminal-key work: parsing, xterm-compatible encoding, whole-sequence validation, Auto-mode checks, and Windows ConPTY coverage. Originated in my PR #234 and landed through #242.

repowise-dev/repowise#4532.title: Trace Apex callouts through wrappers
repowise-dev/repowise#4532.detail: Resolved literal endpoints and HTTP methods through same-class helpers, with safeguards for overloads, reassigned parameters, and unrelated receivers.

repowise-dev/repowise#4553.title: Recognize shared include files accurately
repowise-dev/repowise#4553.detail: Stopped PL/I, Pascal, and PHP include members being mistaken for C++, preserving Abseil fragments and preventing false dead-code findings.
